segments.title: Chương 314: 0330 【Đại Ngưu Ngay Bên Cạnh】
segments.content:
Jinmen.

This was home to Motorola's largest global production base, as well as its hardware R&D center, which was responsible for 70% of the mobile phone R&D tasks in the Asian region.

Qian Chen was the head of hardware here!

To poach such top-tier talent, Chen Guiliang could only try his luck.

As a business part...

Zhao Jing had just put down her coffee cup when the phone rang again. She glanced at Lin Hao, who nodded at her, gesturing for her to take the call. Zhao Jing picked up the phone, pressed the answer button, and spoke in a gentle voice, "Hello, this is the Listener Platform."

A low breathing sound came from the other end of the line. A few seconds later, a young girl's voice said, "I... I've called before, but today, I want to say something different."

Zhao Jing smiled lightly. "Welcome back."

The girl was silent for a moment, her voice trembling slightly. "I... I've decided to go to the hospital for a check-up."

Zhao Jing's heart stirred, and her voice softened. "You've done the right thing."

The girl said in a low voice, "I was always too afraid. I was scared people would think I'm sick, scared of being labeled. But... I'm so tired. I want to live."

Zhao Jing nodded gently, her eyes growing moist. "You've already taken the most important step."

The girl sobbed. "I always felt that no one would understand me, and I didn't want to trouble anyone. But... you've always been here."

Zhao Jing said softly, "We're always here. As long as you're willing to talk, we're willing to listen."

After hanging up, Zhao Jing leaned back in her chair and let out a long breath.

Lin Hao walked over and gently took her hand. "More good news?"

Zhao Jing nodded. "She's decided to go to the hospital for a check-up."

Lin Hao smiled. "Shouldn't we celebrate, then?"

Zhao Jing looked at him and said softly, "We witness miracles every day. We've just gotten used to it."

Lin Hao sat down across from her and picked up his own coffee. "Yeah, we've gotten used to it."

Zhao Jing suddenly asked, "Have you ever thought that one day we might stop?"

Lin Hao looked at her, his gaze firm. "We won't. As long as there are people who need someone to listen, we won't stop."

Zhao Jing nodded gently. "I think so, too."

The night was deep, and the distant lights flickered on one by one, like countless gentle eyes watching over every lonely soul in the city.

They knew that tomorrow, there would still be new calls, new stories, new silences, new tears.

And they would always be here.

"We're listening."

This sentence was like a beam of light, illuminating countless dark nights.

And illuminating themselves.

The door to the activity room was pushed open again. Zhao Jing looked up and saw an unfamiliar middle-aged woman walk in. She wore a dark blue jacket and had a somewhat reserved expression, but her eyes held a hint of hope.

Zhao Jing stood up and said with a smile, "Welcome."

The woman nodded, walked to the center of the room, and scanned her surroundings. She finally found an empty seat in the corner and slowly sat down.

Zhao Jing clapped her hands lightly. "Hello, everyone. We have a new friend joining us today."

A round of applause echoed through the room, not loud, but warm and sincere.

The woman looked at everyone and said softly, "This... this is my first time."

Zhao Jing nodded. "It's okay. We all started with a first time."

The woman took a deep breath and began to speak slowly. "My daughter... she took her own life last year."

The room fell instantly silent, with only the sound of the wind whispering outside the window.

The woman's voice trembled, but she continued, "I always thought she was just feeling down, that it was just teenage rebellion. It wasn't until she was gone that I realized how much pain she'd been in for so, so long."

Tears streamed down her face, but she didn't cry out loud. She just kept talking. "I regret it, I blame myself. I even... I even thought about ending my own life."

Listening to her, Zhao Jing felt her heart tighten. She knew that feeling, that devastating pain of your whole world collapsing.

"But," the woman's voice suddenly grew firm, "I can't just give up like this. She's gone, but I'm still alive. I have to live, live for her."

Another round of applause filled the room, this time more enthusiastic than before.

Lin Hao also spoke up. "Your strength will become a source of strength for others."

The woman nodded gently, a faint smile gracing her lips. "I understand now. I finally understand. I'm not running away. I'm facing it."

In the activity room, sunlight streamed through the windows, illuminating everyone's face. The air seemed to be filled with a new, warm strength.

In the time that followed, several other members shared their stories. One had just emerged from the shadow of divorce, another was battling anxiety, and someone else had finally found the courage to tell their family about their mental state.

Zhao Jing sat in the center of the circle, listening to their voices, a warm current flowing through her heart. She knew they were changing, bit by bit, stepping out of the darkness, bit by bit.

By the time the session ended, it was already late. Zhao Jing stood at the door, seeing off the last member.

"Sister Zhao," Xiao Lin walked up to her and said softly, "I feel like we're really doing something meaningful."

Zhao Jing looked at her and nodded with a smile. "Yes, we really are doing something meaningful."

Lin Hao came over as well and gently took her hand. "Today, we witnessed another rebirth."

Zhao Jing leaned into his embrace and said softly, "Sometimes I think life is like a reboot. We always have to experience loss, pain, and struggle before we can find a reason to live again."

Lin Hao gently stroked her hair. "Yes. And we are the reboot button."

Zhao Jing smiled. "Then let's keep pressing it."

Back in the office, Zhao Jing sat by the window, gazing at the darkening sky outside. The city lights came on one by one, like countless gentle eyes watching over every lonely soul in the city.

"What are you thinking about?" Lin Hao came over and asked softly.

Zhao Jing shook her head. "I'm thinking about how much more we can do."

Lin Hao sat beside her and took her hand. "What we can do is to always be here, listening to them."

Zhao Jing nodded gently. "Yes, we're always here."

The phone rang again, breaking their silence.

Zhao Jing picked up the phone and pressed the answer button. "Hello, this is the Listener Platform."

A low male voice came from the other end. "I... I've called a few times before, but this time, I want to say something different."

Zhao Jing's heart beat a little faster. "If you're willing to talk, we're willing to listen."

The man was silent for a few seconds, then said, "I... I want to live."

Zhao Jing's eyes instantly welled up, but she tried her best to keep her voice steady. "Thank you for being willing to tell us."

The man's voice trembled. "I was just... so tired. But today, I saw the information about your event, saw the stories those people shared, and I suddenly felt that maybe I could... start over, too."

Zhao Jing nodded gently. Even though he couldn't see it, she knew that in this moment, their hearts were connected.

"You've already taken the most important step," she said. "And we will walk with you."

The man sniffled. "Thank you."

Zhao Jing smiled. "No, we should be thanking you. Thank you for making this call."

After hanging up, Zhao Jing leaned back in her chair and let out a long breath.

Lin Hao gently hugged her. "He chose to live again."

Zhao Jing nodded. "Yes, he chose to live."

Lin Hao leaned back in his chair, staring at the ceiling. "Sometimes I wonder, if we hadn't created this platform, would those people have..."

Zhao Jing gently shook her head. "Don't think about that. We did it, and they chose us."

Lin Hao smiled. "You're always like this, so steadfast it puts a person at ease."

Zhao Jing rested her head on his shoulder and said softly, "Because I know that as long as someone needs to be heard, we'll be here."

The night was deep, and the distant lights flickered on one by one, like countless gentle eyes watching over every lonely soul in the city.

They knew that tomorrow, there would still be new calls, new stories, new silences, new tears.

And they would always be here.

"We're listening."

This sentence was like a beam of light, illuminating countless dark nights.

And illuminating themselves.
